words.enDefinition: Granular material such as sand, gravel, or crushed stone used in construction mixtures.

examples.en: The lecturer passed around samples of construction aggregate so we could compare their shapes and textures.
examples.zh: 老师传看几种「建筑集料」样品，让我们比较它们的形状和质地。

examples.en: Our materials chart listed construction aggregate separately from the binder in each illustrated concrete mixture.
examples.zh: 材料表把每种示例混凝土中的「建筑集料」与胶凝材料分开列出。

words.enDefinition: The smaller particles of an aggregate, usually sand or equivalent manufactured material.

examples.en: The mix sheet listed fine aggregate under the heading for sand and similarly sized particles.
examples.zh: 配合比表在砂及粒径相近的材料一栏列出了「细集料」。

examples.en: We compared two samples of fine aggregate and recorded which one had more angular grains.
examples.zh: 我们比较两种「细集料」样品，记录哪一种的颗粒棱角更多。

words.enDefinition: The larger aggregate particles in a mixture, such as gravel or crushed stone.

examples.en: We could see the coarse aggregate in the cut sample because the larger stones were exposed.
examples.zh: 剖开的样品露出较大的石粒，因此我们能看到「粗集料」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to distinguish the coarse aggregate from the cement paste in the photograph.
examples.zh: 习题让我们在照片中区分「粗集料」和水泥浆。

words.enDefinition: Aggregate produced by mechanically breaking larger pieces of rock into smaller particles.

examples.en: The crushed stone aggregate had angular faces that were visible even in the small sample photograph.
examples.zh: 在小幅样品照片上也能看出「碎石集料」带棱角的表面。

examples.en: We labeled the rough particles as crushed stone aggregate on our worksheet about concrete constituents.
examples.zh: 在混凝土组成习题中，我们把粗糙的颗粒标为「碎石集料」。

words.enDefinition: The distribution of particle sizes within a sample of aggregate.

examples.en: The two aggregate gradation curves differed most in the range of smaller particles on our graph.
examples.zh: 图中的两条「集料级配」曲线在较小粒径范围内差别最大。

examples.en: Our tutor used a chart of aggregate gradation to discuss how the particle sizes were distributed.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「集料级配」图说明颗粒尺寸的分布。

words.enDefinition: Aggregate whose size distribution lacks or contains relatively few particles in an intermediate range.

examples.en: We identified the gap-graded aggregate because the chart showed very few particles in the middle range.
examples.zh: 图中中间粒径范围的颗粒很少，我们据此认出了「间断级配集料」。

examples.en: The cutaway photograph helped us distinguish a gap-graded aggregate blend from the continuously graded example.
examples.zh: 剖面照片帮助我们将「间断级配集料」的组合与连续级配样品区分开来。

words.enDefinition: The amount of water in and on aggregate relative to its dry mass.

examples.en: The report listed aggregate moisture content separately because rain had changed the condition of the sand.
examples.zh: 由于下雨改变了砂的含水状态，报告单独列出了「集料含水率」。

examples.en: We compared aggregate moisture content for the two stockpile samples described in the laboratory notes.
examples.zh: 我们比较实验记录里两个料堆样品的「集料含水率」。

words.enDefinition: An aggregate condition with water-filled permeable pores and no surface water film.

examples.en: The saturated surface-dry condition meant the pores held water while each particle's outer surface showed no film.
examples.zh: 「饱和面干状态」指颗粒孔隙中有水，而颗粒表面没有水膜。

examples.en: The report listed dry aggregate mass separately from mass in saturated surface-dry condition for the same sample.
examples.zh: 报告将同一集料样品的干质量与「饱和面干状态」下的质量分开列出。

collocations: report mass in saturated surface-dry condition

words.enDefinition: A material that contributes to the binding and strength of a cement-based mixture through chemical reaction.

examples.en: The table listed each cementitious material beneath the binder heading on the sample mix sheet.
examples.zh: 示例配合比表在胶结料一栏下列出了各种「胶凝材料」。

examples.en: We discussed why a cementitious material could affect the strength of the hardened paste in the report.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了报告中的「胶凝材料」为什么会影响硬化浆体的强度。

words.enDefinition: A hydraulic cement made mainly by grinding Portland cement clinker with a calcium sulfate source.

examples.en: The tutor pointed out Portland cement as the main binder in the reference concrete mixture.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，参考混凝土配合比中使用的主要胶凝材料是「硅酸盐水泥」。

examples.en: Our materials chart distinguished Portland cement from the sand and stone that filled the hardened sample.
examples.zh: 材料表区分了「硅酸盐水泥」和填充在硬化试样中的砂石。

collocations: a paste made with Portland cement

words.enDefinition: Cement that sets and hardens by reaction with water and can continue hardening underwater.

examples.en: We called the binder a hydraulic cement because it could harden while remaining in contact with water.
examples.zh: 这种胶结料与水接触时能够继续硬化，因此我们把它归为「水硬性水泥」。

examples.en: The textbook grouped several products under hydraulic cement and gave concrete as a familiar application.
examples.zh: 教材把几类产品归入「水硬性水泥」，并以混凝土作为常见应用。

words.enDefinition: A manufactured cement combining Portland cement or clinker with additional cementitious constituents.

examples.en: The blended cement label listed a second constituent alongside the Portland cement clinker in the product.
examples.zh: 「混合水泥」标签除了硅酸盐水泥熟料，还列出了该产品的另一种组分。

examples.en: We compared the blended cement sample with the reference binder by reading their listed components in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看组分表，将「混合水泥」样品与参考胶结料进行比较。

collocations: a mix made with blended cement

words.enDefinition: The binder phase formed by mixing cementitious material with water.

examples.en: The cement paste filled the spaces between grains in the magnified photograph of the concrete sample.
examples.zh: 混凝土样品的放大照片显示，「水泥浆体」填充了颗粒间的空隙。

examples.en: We compared fresh cement paste with the solid paste shown in the second classroom photograph.
examples.zh: 我们把新拌「水泥浆体」与第二张课堂照片里的固态浆体进行了比较。

collocations: the bond between cement paste and aggregate

words.enDefinition: The nodular kiln product ground with other constituents to make cement.

examples.en: The cement clinker sample looked like small gray nodules next to the finely ground cement powder.
examples.zh: 放在细磨水泥粉末旁的「水泥熟料」样品看起来像灰色小颗粒。

examples.en: Our lecturer showed where cement clinker appeared between the kiln and the grinding stage in the process chart.
examples.zh: 老师在流程图中指出了「水泥熟料」位于窑炉与粉磨阶段之间的位置。

words.enDefinition: The chemical reaction of hydraulic cement with water that produces binding compounds.

examples.en: The professor used cement hydration to explain why the specimen warmed slightly after it was mixed.
examples.zh: 老师用「水泥水化」解释了为什么试样拌合后温度略有升高。

examples.en: We saw diagrams showing how cement hydration gradually changed the paste around the original particles.
examples.zh: 我们看了几幅示意图，了解「水泥水化」如何逐渐改变原有颗粒周围的浆体。

words.enDefinition: A pozzolanic or hydraulic material used with cement to modify the binder's properties.

examples.en: The mix report identified the gray powder as a supplementary cementitious material used alongside Portland cement.
examples.zh: 配合比报告指出，这种灰色粉末是与硅酸盐水泥配合使用的「辅助胶凝材料」。

examples.en: We traced the supplementary cementitious material to the binder column rather than the aggregate column in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在胶结料一栏中找到了「辅助胶凝材料」。

collocations: a supplementary cementitious material in a blend

words.enDefinition: Fine particles collected from coal combustion exhaust, some of which are used as a concrete binder component.

examples.en: Our materials folder showed fly ash as a fine powder collected from a coal combustion stream.
examples.zh: 材料手册把「粉煤灰」描述为从煤燃烧的烟气中收集的细粉。

examples.en: The concrete mix sheet listed fly ash in the same binder section as the Portland cement.
examples.zh: 混凝土配合比表把「粉煤灰」和硅酸盐水泥列在同一个胶结料栏内。

collocations: fly ash as a supplementary cementitious material

words.enDefinition: A ground hydraulic material made from rapidly cooled molten blast-furnace slag.

examples.en: The materials card listed ground granulated blast-furnace slag as a finely ground product from ironmaking.
examples.zh: 材料卡说明，「磨细粒化高炉矿渣」是炼铁副产物经过细磨得到的产品。

examples.en: We found ground granulated blast-furnace slag in the binder column of the classroom concrete mix table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂混凝土配合比表的胶结料一栏找到了「磨细粒化高炉矿渣」。

collocations: concrete with ground granulated blast-furnace slag
a blend containing ground granulated blast-furnace slag
ground granulated blast-furnace slag as a binder

words.enDefinition: An ultrafine silica-rich powder collected from silicon or ferrosilicon production.

examples.en: The tutor showed silica fume beside the other powders so we could compare the labeled samples.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把「硅灰」放在其他粉料旁，让我们比较这些带标签的样品。

examples.en: Our notes listed silica fume as a reactive binder ingredient obtained during silicon alloy production.
examples.zh: 笔记把「硅灰」列为硅合金生产中获得的一种活性胶结料组分。

words.enDefinition: A naturally sourced siliceous or aluminous material that reacts with calcium hydroxide and water to form binding compounds.

examples.en: The label identified the volcanic powder as a natural pozzolan in the binder comparison display.
examples.zh: 胶结料比较展板的标签注明，这种火山粉料属于「天然火山灰质材料」。

examples.en: We compared a natural pozzolan from volcanic rock with an industrial byproduct in the materials lecture.
examples.zh: 材料课上，我们将取自火山岩的「天然火山灰质材料」与一种工业副产物作了比较。

collocations: a blend with a natural pozzolan

words.enDefinition: Clay heat-treated to make suitable minerals reactive for use in a cementitious binder.

examples.en: The presentation identified calcined clay as the heat-treated powder used in one blended cement sample.
examples.zh: 演示文稿指出，「煅烧黏土」就是一种混合水泥样品中采用的经热处理粉料。

examples.en: We matched calcined clay to the sample description that mentioned heating a clay source before grinding.
examples.zh: 我们把「煅烧黏土」与一项样品说明对应起来，其中提到黏土经加热后粉磨。

collocations: calcined clay as a supplementary material

words.enDefinition: Finely ground limestone used as a filler or fine constituent in a cementitious mixture.

examples.en: The mix table identified limestone filler as a finely ground powder in the classroom concrete example.
examples.zh: 配合比表注明，课堂混凝土示例中的「石灰石填料」是一种细磨粉料。

examples.en: The tutor compared the grain sizes of limestone filler and the visibly coarser limestone aggregate sample.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了「石灰石填料」与明显更粗的石灰石集料样品的粒径。

words.enDefinition: The mass of mixing water divided by the mass of cement in a mixture.

examples.en: We read the water-cement ratio beside the mass of cement on the simplified concrete mix sheet.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的混凝土配合比表中，从水泥质量旁边读出了「水灰比」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the water-cement ratio differed between two examples that used the same cement mass.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，水泥质量相同的两道例题中，「水灰比」有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: The mass of mixing water divided by the total mass of cementitious materials.

examples.en: The example listed a water-cementitious materials ratio because the binder included both cement and fly ash.
examples.zh: 由于胶结料同时含有水泥和粉煤灰，例题列出了「水胶比」。

examples.en: We checked which ingredients counted toward the water-cementitious materials ratio in the sample mixture table.
examples.zh: 我们核对样例配合比表中，哪些组分计入「水胶比」的计算。

words.enDefinition: An ingredient other than water, aggregate, or cementitious material added to modify concrete properties.

examples.en: The mix sheet named a concrete admixture and showed its intended effect on the fresh mixture.
examples.zh: 配合比表列明一种「混凝土外加剂」，并说明希望它对新拌混合料起到什么作用。

examples.en: The lecturer asked why the small bottle was labeled as a concrete admixture in the display.
examples.zh: 老师问，展台上的小瓶为什么标成「混凝土外加剂」。

collocations: the purpose of a concrete admixture

words.enDefinition: An admixture that reduces the water needed to obtain a given concrete consistency.

examples.en: The chart identified a water-reducing admixture in the mix with lower water demand and similar consistency.
examples.zh: 图表在用水需求较低、稠度相近的配合比中标出了一种「减水剂」。

examples.en: We read the note explaining why a water-reducing admixture appeared in the list of concrete ingredients.
examples.zh: 我们读了说明，了解混凝土组分清单中为什么有「减水剂」。

collocations: a mix with a water-reducing admixture
the purpose of a water-reducing admixture

words.enDefinition: An admixture capable of a greater water reduction at comparable consistency than a conventional water reducer.

examples.en: The product table classified the sample as a high-range water reducer and listed superplasticizer as another name.
examples.zh: 产品表把样品归为「高效减水剂」，并注明超塑化剂（superplasticizer）是其别名。

examples.en: We discussed why the report called the ingredient a high-range water reducer rather than an ordinary one.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了报告将这种组分称为「高效减水剂」的原因。

collocations: a high-range water reducer in a mix
concrete containing a high-range water reducer

words.enDefinition: An admixture that delays the setting of cement paste, mortar, or concrete.

examples.en: The case study mentioned a set retarder when explaining why one batch remained workable for longer.
examples.zh: 案例提到一种「缓凝剂」，用以解释为什么其中一批混合料保持和易性的时间更长。

examples.en: We matched the set retarder label to the graph showing a later start of setting.
examples.zh: 我们把「缓凝剂」标签与显示开始凝结较晚的曲线对应起来。

collocations: a concrete mix with a set retarder
the effect of a set retarder

words.enDefinition: An admixture that speeds the setting of cement paste, mortar, or concrete.

examples.en: The example containing a set accelerator reached the marked setting point sooner on the classroom graph.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，加入「促凝剂」的示例更早到达标记的凝结点。

examples.en: We compared the manufacturer's stated purpose of a set accelerator with the purpose of a retarder.
examples.zh: 我们对比厂家说明的「促凝剂」用途与缓凝剂的用途。

collocations: a concrete mix with a set accelerator
the effect of a set accelerator

words.enDefinition: An admixture that intentionally creates small, stable air bubbles in fresh concrete.

examples.en: The instructor pointed to small bubbles in the sketch illustrating the purpose of an air-entraining admixture.
examples.zh: 老师指着示意图中的小气泡，说明「引气剂」的用途。

examples.en: The ingredient list showed an air-entraining admixture alongside the binder, water and aggregates in the example.
examples.zh: 示例组分清单列出的除了胶结料、水和集料，还有一种「引气剂」。

collocations: a mix with an air-entraining admixture
the effect of an air-entraining admixture

words.enDefinition: Concrete containing intentionally introduced small, distributed air voids.

examples.en: The photograph of air-entrained concrete showed small voids scattered throughout the hardened paste in the sample.
examples.zh: 「引气混凝土」的照片显示，样品的硬化浆体中分布着小气孔。

examples.en: We read why air-entrained concrete appeared in a lesson about repeated freezing and thawing of wet samples.
examples.zh: 学习湿试样的反复冻融时，我们阅读了有关「引气混凝土」的说明。

collocations: compare air-entrained concrete with a reference mix

words.enDefinition: Concrete produced for delivery to a project as a fresh mixture.

examples.en: The sample ticket identified the material as ready-mixed concrete delivered from a plant to the project.
examples.zh: 示例票据将这种材料标为由搅拌站运到项目现场的「预拌混凝土」。

examples.en: We found ready-mixed concrete on the delivery schedule alongside the area named in the classroom case study.
examples.zh: 我们在供货进度表上找到了「预拌混凝土」，旁边标出了课堂案例提到的区域。

words.enDefinition: Concrete cast and hardened before being moved to its final position.

examples.en: The illustration showed precast concrete panels arriving at the model hall as finished pieces ready for assembly.
examples.zh: 插图显示，「预制混凝土」面板以待安装的成品构件形式运抵展馆模型。

examples.en: We identified the precast concrete elements by matching their labels with the assembly drawings in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把部件标签与装配图对应起来，识别出「预制混凝土」构件。

words.enDefinition: Concrete placed and hardened in its final position.

examples.en: The section drawing labeled the slab as cast-in-place concrete within the shaded part of the structure.
examples.zh: 剖面图在结构的阴影区域内把板标为「现浇混凝土」。

examples.en: Our classroom timeline showed the cast-in-place concrete wall being formed and hardened in its final position.
examples.zh: 课堂时间轴显示，「现浇混凝土」墙在最终位置成形、硬化。

collocations: cast-in-place concrete shown in a section

words.enDefinition: Concrete used without structural reinforcement to carry tensile forces.

examples.en: The detail labeled the thin leveling layer as plain concrete beneath the reinforced part of the example.
examples.zh: 详图标注示例中钢筋混凝土部分下方的薄找平层为「素混凝土」。

examples.en: Our tutor placed the plain concrete sample beside a cut specimen containing steel bars for comparison.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把「素混凝土」样品放在剖开的含钢筋试样旁作比较。

words.enDefinition: Concrete with embedded steel bars or wires that act with it to resist loads.

examples.en: The photograph showed the steel bars visible at the cut end of the reinforced concrete specimen.
examples.zh: 照片显示，「钢筋混凝土」试样切开的端部露出了钢筋。

examples.en: The tutor used a small reinforced concrete model to identify the two main materials in the member.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用小型「钢筋混凝土」模型指出构件中的两种主要材料。

words.enDefinition: Concrete containing discrete fibers distributed throughout the mixture.

examples.en: We saw thin fibers sticking out of the broken surface of the fiber-reinforced concrete sample.
examples.zh: 我们看到「纤维增强混凝土」样品的断面上露出细纤维。

examples.en: The material card for fiber-reinforced concrete described the fibers as spread throughout the mix in this example.
examples.zh: 本例的「纤维增强混凝土」材料卡说明，纤维遍布整个混合料。

words.enDefinition: Concrete with lower density than conventional concrete, often made with lightweight aggregate or additional voids.

examples.en: The lightweight concrete sample had a lower mass than the other specimen of the same size.
examples.zh: 体积相同的两个试样中，「轻质混凝土」样品的质量较小。

examples.en: Our lecture notes linked lightweight concrete to the porous aggregate shown on the materials tray.
examples.zh: 课堂笔记将「轻质混凝土」与材料托盘上展示的多孔集料联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Flowable concrete designed to fill forms and surround reinforcement without mechanical consolidation.

examples.en: The class saw a model showing self-consolidating concrete flowing into narrow spaces around the reinforcing bars.
examples.zh: 课堂模型展示了「自密实混凝土」流入钢筋周围狭窄空隙的情形。

examples.en: The worksheet associated self-consolidating concrete with a spread measurement from its fresh mixture test.
examples.zh: 习题将「自密实混凝土」与新拌混合料试验中的扩展度数据联系起来。

collocations: compare self-consolidating concrete with a conventional mix

words.enDefinition: Concrete with interconnected voids that allow water to pass through.

examples.en: The teaching sample of pervious concrete had connected gaps that were easy to see in the light.
examples.zh: 光照下，教学用「透水混凝土」样品中互相连通的空隙清晰可见。

examples.en: We examined a cross section of pervious concrete when studying the connection between voids and water passage.
examples.zh: 学习孔隙如何影响水的通过时，我们观察了「透水混凝土」的横截面。

words.enDefinition: Recently mixed concrete that is still plastic and has not yet set.

examples.en: The photographer labeled the wet material in the tray as fresh concrete in our laboratory handout.
examples.zh: 实验讲义把托盘照片中的湿料标为「新拌混凝土」。

examples.en: Our table lists air content under fresh concrete alongside the observations about consistency and appearance.
examples.zh: 我们的表把含气量与稠度及外观观察结果一同列在「新拌混凝土」栏下。

words.enDefinition: Concrete that has set and gained a solid structure through continued hardening.

examples.en: We examined a broken piece of hardened concrete to see the stone particles inside the binder.
examples.zh: 我们观察了一块断开的「硬化混凝土」，辨认胶结料中的石粒。

examples.en: The report placed the strength results in the hardened concrete section next to photographs of broken samples.
examples.zh: 报告把强度结果放在「硬化混凝土」一节，旁边配有试样破坏后的照片。

collocations: a cross section of hardened concrete

words.enDefinition: How readily fresh concrete can be mixed, placed, consolidated, and finished while remaining uniform.

examples.en: We discussed concrete workability when comparing how readily two fresh mixtures filled the same classroom model.
examples.zh: 比较两种新拌料填满同一课堂模型的难易程度时，我们讨论了「混凝土和易性」。

examples.en: The report discussed concrete workability separately from strength because the words described different stages of the material.
examples.zh: 报告将「混凝土和易性」与强度分开讨论，因为这两个词描述材料的不同阶段。

collocations: concrete workability in a fresh mix

words.enDefinition: The vertical decrease in fresh concrete height measured in a cone test.

examples.en: The chart reported concrete slump as the vertical drop of the sample shown in the photograph.
examples.zh: 图表用照片中试样竖向下沉的高度表示「混凝土坍落度」。

examples.en: We compared the recorded concrete slump values from two mixtures in the same set of laboratory notes.
examples.zh: 我们比较同一份实验记录中两种混合料的「混凝土坍落度」。

words.enDefinition: A test that uses a fresh concrete sample's vertical drop as an indicator of consistency.

examples.en: The instructor used a diagram of the slump test to explain the vertical dimension in our table.
examples.zh: 老师用「坍落度试验」示意图解释了我们表格里的竖向尺寸。

examples.en: The notes assigned a separate page to the slump test and described its result as a length.
examples.zh: 笔记用单独一页介绍「坍落度试验」，并说明其结果用长度表示。

collocations: the result of a slump test

words.enDefinition: The horizontal spread diameter of a highly flowable fresh concrete sample in a specified test.

examples.en: The report described slump flow as the width of the spread once the concrete stopped moving.
examples.zh: 报告用混凝土停止流动后铺开的宽度表示「坍落扩展度」。

examples.en: The tutor marked the horizontal distance used for slump flow on the classroom sketch of the sample.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在试样课堂草图中标出用于表示「坍落扩展度」的水平距离。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of a concrete sample's volume occupied by air voids.

examples.en: We entered concrete air content in the table as a percentage of the sample's total volume.
examples.zh: 我们在表中把「混凝土含气量」填成占试样总体积的百分比。

examples.en: The laboratory chart compared concrete air content for two fresh samples that looked similar at first.
examples.zh: 实验图比较了两种起初看起来相似的新拌试样的「混凝土含气量」。

collocations: a difference in concrete air content

words.enDefinition: Small, deliberately introduced air bubbles distributed through concrete or a similar mixture.

examples.en: In the enlarged sketch, entrained air appeared as many small bubbles dispersed throughout the cement paste.
examples.zh: 放大草图中，许多「引入的气泡」分散在水泥浆体中。

examples.en: We compared entrained air in the report with the larger accidental pockets shown in the other photograph.
examples.zh: 我们把报告中「引入的气泡」与另一张照片上较大的意外夹带气孔作了比较。

collocations: a system of entrained air voids

words.enDefinition: Air unintentionally caught in a mixture, often forming relatively large or irregular voids.

examples.en: The cut surface showed irregular holes that the lab worksheet attributed to entrapped air in the mixture.
examples.zh: 断面上有不规则孔洞，实验习题归因于混合料中的「夹带空气」。

examples.en: The note listed entrapped air separately from the bubbles deliberately introduced to one reference sample.
examples.zh: 说明把「夹带空气」与参考样品中有意引入的气泡分别列出。

words.enDefinition: The upward movement of water in fresh concrete as solid particles settle.

examples.en: We recognized bleeding of concrete in the time sequence when water first appeared on the sample surface.
examples.zh: 我们在连续图像中看到试样表面首次出现水，据此认出「混凝土泌水」。

examples.en: The worksheet linked bleeding of concrete to settling particles beneath the shiny surface in the photograph.
examples.zh: 习题把「混凝土泌水」与照片中反光表面下方的颗粒沉降联系起来。

collocations: bleeding of concrete at the surface

words.enDefinition: Separation of fresh concrete constituents that makes their distribution uneven.

examples.en: The tray photograph showed concrete segregation where large stones had collected away from the wetter paste.
examples.zh: 托盘照片中，大石粒聚集在远离较湿浆体的地方，显示出「混凝土离析」。

examples.en: We looked for concrete segregation in the classroom images by checking whether the mixture still appeared uniform.
examples.zh: 我们查看课堂图片中的混合料是否仍然均匀，以判断有无「混凝土离析」。

words.enDefinition: An early defined milestone in the loss of plasticity of cement paste or fresh concrete, identified by a specified test.

examples.en: The material chart marked initial set near the beginning of the interval when the paste lost plasticity.
examples.zh: 材料图在浆体开始失去塑性的区段前端标出了「初凝」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the recorded time of initial set differed between the two binder samples.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释了为什么两个胶结料样品记录的「初凝」时间不同。

words.enDefinition: The later defined stage at which a cementitious mixture has sufficiently stiffened under a setting test criterion.

examples.en: The table marked final set later than initial set for both of the samples we studied.
examples.zh: 表中两个研究样品的「终凝」均晚于初凝。

examples.en: The tutor located final set on the curve before discussing how strength could continue developing afterward.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先在曲线上找出「终凝」，再说明之后强度如何继续增长。

words.enDefinition: The development of solid structure and mechanical strength as the binder reacts over time.

examples.en: We tracked concrete hardening in the example by comparing strength results from specimens tested at different ages.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们用不同龄期试样的强度结果来追踪「混凝土硬化」。

examples.en: The instructor drew a timeline to show how concrete hardening continued beyond the marked setting points.
examples.zh: 老师用时间轴说明在图示凝结点之后「混凝土硬化」仍会继续。

words.enDefinition: Maintaining moisture and temperature conditions that support cement hydration and property development.

examples.en: The laboratory report described curing of concrete before presenting the strength results for the samples.
examples.zh: 实验报告先介绍「混凝土养护」，再展示各试样的强度结果。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted curing of concrete when explaining why the same mix produced different results in two groups.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释同一配合比为何在两组中结果不同，并重点说明了「混凝土养护」。

collocations: compare methods for curing of concrete

words.enDefinition: The process of compacting fresh concrete to reduce entrapped air and fill spaces.

examples.en: The classroom diagram showed fewer large pockets after concrete consolidation in the pictured specimen.
examples.zh: 课堂图示显示，试样经过「混凝土密实」后，大气孔变少了。

examples.en: We read a note about concrete consolidation when interpreting the voids along the edge of the sample.
examples.zh: 解释试样边缘孔洞时，我们阅读了一则关于「混凝土密实」的说明。

words.enDefinition: The mass per unit volume of concrete measured while it is fresh.

examples.en: The table gave the wet density of concrete for each mixture before the samples hardened.
examples.zh: 表格给出了各配合比试样硬化前的「新拌混凝土密度」。

examples.en: We checked the units beside wet density of concrete because the worksheet listed both mass and volume.
examples.zh: 习题同时列出质量和体积，因此我们核对了「新拌混凝土密度」旁的单位。

collocations: measure the wet density of concrete
report the wet density of concrete
compare values of the wet density of concrete

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical concrete specimen prepared for measuring a material property, commonly compressive strength.

examples.en: Each concrete test cylinder in the photo carried the batch identifier used in the results table.
examples.zh: 照片中的每件「混凝土圆柱试件」都标有结果表使用的批次编号。

examples.en: Our tutor passed around a concrete test cylinder so we could recognize its shape in reports.
examples.zh: 辅导老师传看一个「混凝土圆柱试件」，让我们能在报告中认出这种形状。

collocations: results for a concrete test cylinder

words.enDefinition: A cube-shaped concrete sample made for a material test, commonly compressive strength.

examples.en: We recognized the concrete cube specimen in the photograph because it had six square faces.
examples.zh: 照片里的「混凝土立方体试件」有六个正方形面，我们据此认出了它。

examples.en: The lab worksheet listed the concrete cube specimen in a separate row from the cylindrical sample.
examples.zh: 实验习题将「混凝土立方体试件」与圆柱形试样分行列出。

collocations: results for a concrete cube specimen

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical sample removed from already hardened concrete for examination or testing.

examples.en: The report used a concrete core sample to show the visible layers inside the existing slab.
examples.zh: 报告通过「混凝土芯样」展示现有板件内部可见的层次。

examples.en: Our class compared a concrete core sample with a cylinder that had been made in a mold.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们将「混凝土芯样」与在模具中制作的圆柱试件进行比较。

collocations: strength results for a concrete core sample

words.enDefinition: The greatest compressive stress a concrete specimen sustains under a stated test method.

examples.en: The worksheet listed the compressive strength of concrete beside pictures of the two broken specimens.
examples.zh: 习题在两个破坏试件的图片旁列出了「混凝土抗压强度」。

examples.en: We recorded the specimen shape before comparing the compressive strength of concrete from two test reports.
examples.zh: 比较两份报告中的「混凝土抗压强度」前，我们先记录了试件形状。

collocations: report the compressive strength of concrete
measure the compressive strength of concrete
compare the compressive strength of concrete samples

words.enDefinition: A test that estimates tensile strength from a specimen's resistance to splitting under compression.

examples.en: The splitting tensile test photograph showed a crack crossing the circular face of the concrete cylinder.
examples.zh: 「劈裂抗拉试验」照片显示，混凝土圆柱的圆形端面上有一道贯穿的裂缝。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the splitting tensile test was presented as an indirect measure of tensile strength.
examples.zh: 辅导老师说明了为什么「劈裂抗拉试验」被归为间接测量抗拉强度的方法。

collocations: results from a splitting tensile test

words.enDefinition: The calculated tensile stress when a concrete beam specimen fails in bending.

examples.en: The bending report listed the flexural strength of concrete beside a diagram of the small test beam.
examples.zh: 弯曲试验报告在小梁试件的示意图旁列出了「混凝土抗折强度」。

examples.en: We found the flexural strength of concrete under the beam test heading rather than the cylinder test heading.
examples.zh: 我们在梁试验一栏找到了「混凝土抗折强度」。

collocations: report the flexural strength of concrete
compare the flexural strength of concrete
data on the flexural strength of concrete

words.enDefinition: A quantity of concrete produced together from one set of measured ingredients.

examples.en: One concrete batch supplied three classroom samples, so their labels shared the same reference number.
examples.zh: 三个课堂样品来自同一「混凝土拌合批次」，因此标签上的参考编号相同。

examples.en: We linked each concrete batch to the relevant mix entry in the laboratory's shared table.
examples.zh: 我们在实验室共用表上将各个「混凝土拌合批次」与相应的配合比条目联系起来。

words.enDefinition: A record identifying a concrete batch and listing its production or delivery details.

examples.en: The instructor asked us to locate the batch ticket that accompanied the example delivery in the case study.
examples.zh: 老师请我们找出案例示例供货随车携带的「混凝土出料单」。

examples.en: We checked the batch ticket for the mix identification before connecting it to the laboratory results.
examples.zh: 我们在「混凝土出料单」上核对配合比编号，再将它与实验结果关联起来。

collocations: the time on a batch ticket
match a batch ticket to a delivery

words.enDefinition: The water taken up by a concrete specimen relative to its dry mass under stated test conditions.

examples.en: We compared the water absorption of concrete for two specimens that had visibly different surface textures.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个表面质地明显不同的试样的「混凝土吸水率」。

examples.en: The water absorption of concrete appeared as a percentage in the table of sample properties.
examples.zh: 样品性质表用百分比表示「混凝土吸水率」。

collocations: measure the water absorption of concrete
report the water absorption of concrete
compare water absorption of concrete samples

words.enDefinition: The ease with which a fluid can pass through connected pathways in concrete.

examples.en: The lecturer explained the permeability of concrete using sketches of connected and isolated pores in the sample.
examples.zh: 老师用试样中连通孔隙和孤立孔隙的草图解释「混凝土渗透性」。

examples.en: The report discussed the permeability of concrete in a section about how water moves through the material.
examples.zh: 报告在水如何穿过材料的一节讨论了「混凝土渗透性」。

words.enDefinition: Contraction of hardened concrete as it loses moisture to its surroundings.

examples.en: The plot showed drying shrinkage after the concrete specimens were exposed to a less humid environment.
examples.zh: 曲线展示了混凝土试样置于湿度较低的环境后发生的「干燥收缩」。

examples.en: We linked drying shrinkage in the textbook example to a gradual decrease in the specimen length.
examples.zh: 我们把教材示例中的「干燥收缩」与试样长度逐渐缩短联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Contraction of a cementitious material caused by internal processes during hydration without external moisture loss.

examples.en: The sealed specimens showed autogenous shrinkage even though moisture did not leave them during the comparison.
examples.zh: 尽管比较过程中没有水分从密封试样逸出，试样仍出现了「自生收缩」。

examples.en: We used the notes about hydration to explain autogenous shrinkage in the sealed paste sample.
examples.zh: 我们根据关于水化的笔记解释密封浆体样品中的「自生收缩」。

words.enDefinition: Gradual additional deformation in hardened concrete under sustained stress.

examples.en: The graph showed concrete creep as the specimen continued deforming while the load remained the same.
examples.zh: 尽管载荷保持不变，图中试样仍继续变形，显示出「混凝土徐变」。

examples.en: We separated the immediate displacement from the later change associated with concrete creep in the example.
examples.zh: 我们区分例题中的即时位移和随后与「混凝土徐变」相关的变形。

collocations: the time dependence of concrete creep

words.enDefinition: A crack that forms when material contraction is restrained or uneven.

examples.en: The caption identified a shrinkage crack in the photograph and described the restraint in the example.
examples.zh: 图片说明指出照片中的一道「收缩裂缝」，并描述了示例中的约束情况。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the thin line we marked was a shrinkage crack or a construction joint.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，我们标出来的细线是「收缩裂缝」还是施工缝。

words.enDefinition: A steel bar embedded in concrete or masonry to carry forces with the surrounding material.

examples.en: We spotted a reinforcing bar in the cut section where the outer concrete had been removed.
examples.zh: 外层混凝土已去除，我们在切开的截面中看见一根「钢筋」。

examples.en: The instructor matched the reinforcing bar in the display to a line on the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 老师把展台中的「钢筋」与课堂图纸上的一条线对应起来。

collocations: the diameter of a reinforcing bar

words.enDefinition: A reinforcing bar with surface ribs or projections that help transfer force to surrounding concrete.

examples.en: The deformed bar in the materials display had raised ribs along the length of its surface.
examples.zh: 材料展台上的「带肋钢筋」表面沿长度方向有凸起的肋。

examples.en: We selected the deformed bar from the tray after comparing the surface textures of three samples.
examples.zh: 我们比较了三个样品的表面质地后，从托盘里认出了「带肋钢筋」。

collocations: the ribs of a deformed bar

words.enDefinition: A smooth round reinforcing bar without the ribs found on a deformed bar.

examples.en: The plain reinforcing bar felt smooth when we compared the demonstration samples in our materials class.
examples.zh: 在材料课上比较演示样品时，我们发现「光圆钢筋」摸起来很光滑。

examples.en: The worksheet identified the smooth cylinder in the photograph as a plain reinforcing bar sample.
examples.zh: 习题把照片中的光滑圆杆标为「光圆钢筋」样品。

collocations: the surface of a plain reinforcing bar
compare a plain reinforcing bar with a ribbed bar

words.enDefinition: A three-dimensional assembly of reinforcing bars arranged to be embedded in concrete.

examples.en: The rebar cage in the photo stood beside the small column form in the case study.
examples.zh: 案例照片中的「钢筋笼」立在小型柱模旁。

examples.en: We counted the vertical bars visible in the model rebar cage before locating them on the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们数出模型「钢筋笼」中看得见的竖向钢筋，再在图纸上找出它们的位置。

collocations: a rebar cage for a column
label the parts of a rebar cage

words.enDefinition: A flat grid of reinforcing bars or wires placed within a concrete element.

examples.en: The section sketch showed a reinforcement mat near each face of the teaching slab model.
examples.zh: 教学板模型的剖面草图在两个表面附近各画出一层「钢筋网片」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the flat reinforcement mat before showing a model of a column cage.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先指出平面的「钢筋网片」，再展示一个柱钢筋笼模型。

collocations: the orientation of a reinforcement mat

words.enDefinition: Steel wires welded at their intersections to form reinforcement for concrete.

examples.en: The sample of welded wire reinforcement showed a regular grid with small welds at each intersection.
examples.zh: 「焊接钢丝网」样品呈规则网格，每个交点有小焊点。

examples.en: We found welded wire reinforcement listed in the slab detail beside a simple drawing of the grid.
examples.zh: 我们在板详图中看到「焊接钢丝网」的标注，旁边有一幅网格简图。

collocations: a sheet of welded wire reinforcement
the intersections of welded wire reinforcement

words.enDefinition: A device placed between reinforcement and a form to maintain the intended concrete cover.

examples.en: The rebar spacer was shown between the rod and the form wall in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图纸把「钢筋垫块」画在钢筋与模板内壁之间。

examples.en: The materials tray contained a rebar spacer that the tutor identified from its position in the model.
examples.zh: 材料托盘里有一个「钢筋垫块」，辅导老师根据它在模型中的位置认出了它。

collocations: the position of a rebar spacer

words.enDefinition: A support shaped to hold reinforcing bars or a reinforcement mat at the intended height.

examples.en: Our class saw a bar chair beneath the upper reinforcement layer in the transparent slab model.
examples.zh: 我们看见透明楼板模型的上层钢筋下方有一个「钢筋马凳」。

examples.en: The illustration used a bar chair symbol beside the line showing the intended height of the bars.
examples.zh: 插图在标示钢筋预定高度的线旁使用了「钢筋马凳」符号。

collocations: a bar chair for the upper reinforcement
the height of a bar chair

words.enDefinition: Flexible wire used to hold reinforcing bars in position during assembly.

examples.en: We recognized the tie wire as the thin loop around the crossing bars in the model.
examples.zh: 我们认出模型中绕在交叉钢筋处的细圈是「钢筋绑扎丝」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the tie wire when explaining how the sample cage kept its shape.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指着「钢筋绑扎丝」，解释样品钢筋笼如何保持形状。

collocations: tie wire at a bar crossing
identify tie wire in a cage

words.enDefinition: A drawing or schedule identifier for a reinforcing bar type with specified detailing information.

examples.en: We used the bar mark in the diagram to find the matching shape in the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们根据图中的「钢筋编号」，在明细表中找出对应的形状。

examples.en: The same bar mark appeared twice because both positions called for the same listed bar shape.
examples.zh: 两个位置需要使用明细表中同一种形状的钢筋，因此出现了相同的「钢筋编号」。

collocations: match a bar mark to a schedule
a bar mark on a detail

words.enDefinition: A schedule listing reinforcing bar identifiers, quantities, dimensions, and bending shapes.

examples.en: The bar bending schedule linked each drawing label to its listed bar shape and quantity.
examples.zh: 「钢筋加工明细表」将图纸上的各个编号与所列钢筋形状和数量对应起来。

examples.en: Our exercise used a bar bending schedule to distinguish two reinforcing bars with different shaped ends.
examples.zh: 我们用「钢筋加工明细表」区分两根端部形状不同的钢筋。

collocations: a bar mark in a bar bending schedule

words.enDefinition: A reinforcement connection in which bar ends overlap so that forces can transfer through surrounding material.

examples.en: The figure labeled the region where the two bars overlapped as a lap splice in the detail.
examples.zh: 详图把两根钢筋重叠的区域标为「搭接接头」。

examples.en: We compared a lap splice with a connection that used a separate sleeve between the bars.
examples.zh: 我们把「搭接接头」与两根钢筋之间使用独立套筒的连接方式作了比较。

collocations: a lap splice between reinforcing bars
the location of a lap splice

words.enDefinition: A connection transferring force between reinforcing bars through a mechanical joining device.

examples.en: The mechanical splice appeared as a short sleeve connecting two bars in the cutaway photograph.
examples.zh: 剖面照片中，「机械连接接头」表现为连接两根钢筋的短套筒。

examples.en: We searched the drawing legend for the symbol used to identify a mechanical splice in the model.
examples.zh: 我们查阅图例，找出模型中表示「机械连接接头」的符号。

collocations: a detail showing a mechanical splice

words.enDefinition: A mechanical device that joins the ends of two reinforcing bars.

examples.en: The tutor passed around a reinforcement coupler so we could recognize the part shown on the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师传看一个「钢筋连接套筒」，让我们认出图纸中的对应零件。

examples.en: The reinforcement coupler appeared as a thicker component where the two model bars met in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中两根模型钢筋相接处画了一个较粗的零件，就是「钢筋连接套筒」。

words.enDefinition: The interaction that transfers force between embedded reinforcing steel and the surrounding concrete.

examples.en: The lecturer discussed reinforcement bond when explaining how force passed from the bar into the surrounding concrete.
examples.zh: 老师讲到力如何从钢筋传递到周围混凝土时，介绍了「钢筋与混凝土的黏结」。

examples.en: The second sketch showed how the surface ribs contributed to reinforcement bond in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 第二幅草图展示了例题中表面肋纹如何影响「钢筋与混凝土的黏结」。

collocations: the effect of ribs on reinforcement bond

words.enDefinition: The thickness of concrete between its surface and the nearest surface of embedded reinforcement.

examples.en: The section drawing marked concrete cover as the gap from the outer face to the nearest steel.
examples.zh: 剖面图用外表面至最近钢筋表面的距离表示「混凝土保护层」厚度。

examples.en: We highlighted concrete cover in the drawing while reading the case about reinforcement durability.
examples.zh: 阅读钢筋耐久性案例时，我们在图上高亮了「混凝土保护层」。

words.enDefinition: The intended concrete cover stated on design documents, as distinct from the thickness measured in place.

examples.en: The designer's note gave nominal cover, while the case study table recorded thicknesses observed in the sample.
examples.zh: 设计说明给出「名义保护层厚度」，案例表格则记录试样中观测到的实际厚度。

examples.en: We found nominal cover next to the reinforcement symbols on the section provided in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题所附剖面图的钢筋符号旁找到了「名义保护层厚度」。

collocations: the nominal cover on a reinforcement drawing

words.enDefinition: Chemical or electrochemical degradation of steel reinforcement embedded in a construction material.

examples.en: The condition report listed reinforcement corrosion as one possible explanation for the rust stains in the photograph.
examples.zh: 状况报告将「钢筋锈蚀」列为照片中锈迹的一个可能原因。

examples.en: Our lecturer used the diagram to connect reinforcement corrosion with cracks running along the bars.
examples.zh: 老师用示意图说明「钢筋锈蚀」与沿钢筋延伸的裂缝之间的关系。

words.enDefinition: The movement of chloride ions from the environment into concrete.

examples.en: The report discussed chloride ingress after showing measurements at several depths below the exposed concrete surface.
examples.zh: 报告先展示混凝土暴露表面以下不同深度的测量数据，再讨论「氯离子侵入」。

examples.en: We located the graph of chloride ingress in the section about concrete samples exposed to saltwater.
examples.zh: 我们在关于接触盐水的混凝土试样一节中找到了「氯离子侵入」的图表。

words.enDefinition: Reaction of penetrating carbon dioxide with cementitious compounds in concrete, reducing its alkalinity.

examples.en: The tutor used a cross section to show how carbonation of concrete can advance from exposed surfaces.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用横截面说明「混凝土碳化」如何从暴露表面向内发展。

examples.en: We read about carbonation of concrete in the report section that discussed changes in the binder's alkalinity.
examples.zh: 报告讨论胶结料碱度变化的部分介绍了「混凝土碳化」。

collocations: the depth of carbonation of concrete

words.enDefinition: A reaction between alkalis and reactive silica in concrete aggregate that can cause expansion and cracking.

examples.en: The case study considered alkali-silica reaction after noting the pattern of cracks on several concrete samples.
examples.zh: 案例记录几件混凝土试样的裂缝形态后，考虑了「碱硅反应」的可能性。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted reactive silica in the material description while explaining the term alkali-silica reaction in class.
examples.zh: 课上，辅导老师解释「碱硅反应」时，在材料说明中特别标出了活性二氧化硅。

words.enDefinition: Material deterioration caused by repeated freezing and thawing in the presence of moisture.

examples.en: The photo series showed more freeze-thaw damage after repeated cycles in the classroom durability example.
examples.zh: 课堂耐久性示例的系列照片显示，反复循环后「冻融损伤」更明显。

examples.en: We looked for freeze-thaw damage in the section of the report about cold and wet conditions.
examples.zh: 我们在报告中关于寒冷潮湿环境的一节查找「冻融损伤」的描述。

words.enDefinition: Flaking or peeling away of the near-surface mortar of hardened concrete.

examples.en: The picture caption identified scaling of concrete where thin flakes had broken away from the surface.
examples.zh: 图片说明指出，表面有薄片脱落的位置出现了「混凝土表面剥蚀」。

examples.en: We used the closeup to distinguish scaling of concrete from the deeper loss shown in another panel.
examples.zh: 我们借助近景区分「混凝土表面剥蚀」与另一栏图片所示的较深剥落。

collocations: a photo showing the scaling of concrete
the extent of scaling of concrete

words.enDefinition: The breaking away of pieces from a hardened concrete surface or edge.

examples.en: The inspector's example photo showed concrete spalling where a piece had broken away from the corner.
examples.zh: 检查记录的示例照片显示，角部脱落一块材料，形成了「混凝土剥落」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked us to mark concrete spalling on the drawing before comparing the images.
examples.zh: 习题让我们先在图上标出「混凝土剥落」，再比较各张图片。

words.enDefinition: A surface deposit of soluble salts left when moisture moves through masonry or concrete and evaporates.

examples.en: The tutor labeled the white deposits on the classroom brick samples as examples of efflorescence.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把课堂砖样上的白色沉积物标为「泛碱」实例。

examples.en: The report noted efflorescence near the mortar joints after showing photographs taken during the wet period.
examples.zh: 报告展示潮湿期间拍摄的照片后，记录了灰缝附近出现的「泛碱」。

words.enDefinition: A visibly porous region left where mortar did not fill spaces between coarse aggregate near the surface.

examples.en: The panel photograph showed surface honeycombing where stones were visible around a cluster of unfilled spaces.
examples.zh: 面板照片中，未填满的孔隙周围露出了石粒，可见「混凝土蜂窝」。

examples.en: We compared surface honeycombing with isolated small air holes in a separate sample shown by the tutor.
examples.zh: 我们将「混凝土蜂窝」与辅导老师展示的另一个试样上的孤立小气孔作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A weak surface layer of cement and fine particles deposited by upward water movement in fresh concrete.

examples.en: The report described the pale surface film as concrete laitance after examining the cut sample photograph.
examples.zh: 报告查看试样剖面照片后，将浅色表层描述为「混凝土浮浆」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to concrete laitance when explaining the difference between surface material and the paste below.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指着「混凝土浮浆」，说明表面材料与下方浆体的不同。

words.enDefinition: A flowable cement-based mixture used to fill gaps, joints, or other spaces.

examples.en: The drawing labeled the thin layer beneath the model plate as cement grout in the case study.
examples.zh: 案例图将模型底板下的薄层标注为「水泥灌浆料」。

examples.en: We identified cement grout in the illustration by matching its label with the filled space below the piece.
examples.zh: 我们将标签与构件下方已填充的空间对应起来，在插图中找到了「水泥灌浆料」。

words.enDefinition: An interface where one concrete placement ends and a later placement begins.

examples.en: The pour sequence drawing used a dashed line to mark the construction joint between two planned placements.
examples.zh: 浇筑顺序图用虚线标出了两次计划浇筑之间的「施工缝」。

examples.en: We found the construction joint on the schedule boundary separating the first and second concrete placements.
examples.zh: 我们在进度图上第一、二次混凝土浇筑的分界处找到了「施工缝」。

collocations: a detail of a construction joint

words.enDefinition: A deliberate joint used to accommodate shrinkage or localize shrinkage cracking, depending on the construction material.

examples.en: The instructor identified the straight line in the slab model as a control joint in the example.
examples.zh: 老师指出，示例中楼板模型上的直线表示「控制缝」。

examples.en: We used the plan legend to tell a control joint from a line dividing two concrete placements.
examples.zh: 我们用平面图图例区分「控制缝」与划分两次混凝土浇筑的线。

collocations: a control joint on a plan

words.enDefinition: An individual brick, block, or stone used as a component of masonry.

examples.en: We chose one masonry unit from the tray and found its matching outline in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们从托盘里选取一个「砌体单元」，在图纸上找出相应的轮廓。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the larger masonry unit when comparing the two wall models in class.
examples.zh: 课堂比较两个墙体模型时，辅导老师指向较大的「砌体单元」。

collocations: the face of a masonry unit

words.enDefinition: A solid or hollow manufactured concrete unit used to build masonry.

examples.en: The classroom concrete masonry unit had two open cells that were easy to see from above.
examples.zh: 从上面看，课堂展示的「混凝土砌块」有两个清晰可见的开孔。

examples.en: We identified the concrete masonry unit in the section before labeling the spaces between adjacent blocks.
examples.zh: 我们先在剖面图上找出「混凝土砌块」，再标记相邻砌块之间的空隙。

collocations: the cells of a concrete masonry unit

words.enDefinition: A masonry unit made from clay that is shaped and fired.

examples.en: The tray held a fired clay brick beside a concrete block for the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 托盘里放着一块烧制的「黏土砖」和一块混凝土砌块供课堂比较。

examples.en: We recognized the clay brick because its description mentioned shaping and firing the source material.
examples.zh: 我们根据说明中提到原料经过成型和烧制，认出了这件「黏土砖」。

words.enDefinition: A single row or layer of brick, block, or stone units in masonry.

examples.en: The mason's drawing showed one masonry course above the upper edge of the opening in the model.
examples.zh: 砌筑图纸显示，模型洞口上缘上方有「一皮砌体」。

examples.en: We outlined each masonry course on the elevation to check where the pattern began repeating.
examples.zh: 我们在立面图上标出「每一皮砌体」，检查砌筑图案从哪里开始重复。

words.enDefinition: The mortar-filled space between adjacent masonry units.

examples.en: The photo showed a pale mortar joint separating the darker bricks in the sample panel.
examples.zh: 照片里的样板中，一道较浅的「灰缝」隔开了颜色较深的砖。

examples.en: We traced each mortar joint in the drawing to see how the arrangement repeated across the wall.
examples.zh: 我们逐一描出图中的「灰缝」，看这种排列如何在整面墙上重复。

collocations: the profile of a mortar joint

words.enDefinition: The horizontal mortar joint between successive layers of masonry units.

examples.en: We marked the bed joint directly beneath one row of bricks in the classroom elevation.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂立面图的一皮砖正下方标出了「水平灰缝」。

examples.en: The tutor drew a line along the bed joint and then pointed to the shorter vertical joint.
examples.zh: 辅导老师沿「水平灰缝」画了一条线，再指出旁边较短的竖缝。

collocations: the thickness of a bed joint

words.enDefinition: The vertical mortar joint between adjacent masonry units within the same layer.

examples.en: The head joint was shown as a short vertical line between neighboring bricks in the sketch.
examples.zh: 草图用相邻砖之间一条短竖线表示「竖向灰缝」。

examples.en: We moved up one row and checked whether the next head joint aligned with the first.
examples.zh: 我们向上看一皮砖，检查下一道「竖向灰缝」是否与第一道对齐。

collocations: the position of a head joint

words.enDefinition: A masonry pattern in which vertical joints are offset in successive courses.

examples.en: The tutor recognized running bond because the vertical joints shifted from one row to the next.
examples.zh: 各皮砖之间的竖缝相互错开，因此辅导老师认出这是「错缝砌筑」。

examples.en: We compared the running bond sketch with another drawing whose joints lined up vertically across courses.
examples.zh: 我们将「错缝砌筑」草图与另一幅各皮砖竖缝对齐的图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A masonry pattern with vertical joints aligned from one course to the next.

examples.en: The stack bond diagram showed uninterrupted vertical joint lines through several rows of blocks in the elevation.
examples.zh: 「通缝砌筑」立面示意图中的竖缝直贯多皮砌块。

examples.en: We labeled the square grid on the teaching wall drawing as an example of stack bond.
examples.zh: 我们把教学墙体图上的方格排列标为「通缝砌筑」的示例。

words.enDefinition: A flowable cementitious mixture that fills masonry cells or spaces, sometimes around reinforcement.

examples.en: The cutaway displayed masonry grout inside the block cells and mortar between the units in the example.
examples.zh: 剖开示意图展示了砌块孔内的「砌体灌浆料」和砌块间的砂浆。

examples.en: We matched masonry grout to the shaded material in the center of the sample block.
examples.zh: 我们把标注的「砌体灌浆料」与试样砌块中央着色的材料对应起来。

words.enDefinition: Masonry in which specified cells or internal spaces are filled with grout.

examples.en: The grouted masonry specimen showed filled cells when we examined the photograph of its cut surface.
examples.zh: 我们观察「灌浆砌体」试样的截面照片，看到孔洞已经填实。

examples.en: Our handout compared grouted masonry with a model whose block cells were left open for viewing.
examples.zh: 讲义将「灌浆砌体」与一个保留开孔供观察的模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A facing layer of masonry units tied or bonded to a backing wall.

examples.en: The model section showed a thin masonry veneer on the outer side of the wall assembly.
examples.zh: 模型剖面在墙体构造的外侧画了一层薄薄的「砌体饰面」。

examples.en: We highlighted the masonry veneer in the elevation and located its backing on the next sheet.
examples.zh: 我们在立面图上高亮了「砌体饰面」，在下一张图上找到了它的背衬。

collocations: the backing behind a masonry veneer

words.enDefinition: Solid wood cut from logs into boards or other rectangular pieces.

examples.en: The sawn lumber sample showed continuous grain lines across its broad face in the classroom display.
examples.zh: 课堂展台上的「锯材」样品宽面上有连贯的木纹。

examples.en: We compared sawn lumber with the layered wood product shown on the next materials card.
examples.zh: 我们将「锯材」与下一张材料卡上的层状木制品作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Lumber dried in a chamber with controlled temperature and humidity.

examples.en: The materials label said kiln-dried lumber and described how the board's moisture had been reduced.
examples.zh: 材料标签注明这是「窑干木材」，并说明板材的含水量如何降低。

examples.en: We found kiln-dried lumber in the sample list beside a board described as air dried.
examples.zh: 我们在样品清单中看到「窑干木材」和旁边一块标注为自然风干的板材。

collocations: the moisture content of kiln-dried lumber

words.enDefinition: Sawn lumber supplied in standardized nominal widths and thicknesses.

examples.en: The dimensional lumber table listed standard cross-sectional sizes beside photos of the example pieces of wood.
examples.zh: 「规格锯材」表在示例木料的照片旁列出了常规横截面规格。

examples.en: We used the note about dimensional lumber to identify the solid wood pieces in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们根据「规格锯材」的说明识别课堂模型里的实木构件。

words.enDefinition: Wood products manufactured by bonding smaller pieces, veneers, or strands into components.

examples.en: Our tutor used three engineered wood samples to show different ways of combining smaller wood elements.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用三个「工程木材」试样展示组合小木质单元的不同方式。

examples.en: The report grouped the layered panel under engineered wood and described the material between its layers.
examples.zh: 报告把这种层状板材归入「工程木材」，并说明了其层间材料。

words.enDefinition: Engineered lumber formed by bonding thin wood veneers with most grain directions parallel.

examples.en: The cut end of the laminated veneer lumber showed several thin, tightly bonded wood layers in the photograph.
examples.zh: 照片中，「单板层积材」的端部切面露出数层紧密胶合的薄木片。

examples.en: We traced the grain direction on the laminated veneer lumber diagram while comparing it with plywood.
examples.zh: 比较「单板层积材」和胶合板时，我们在前者的示意图上描出了木纹方向。

collocations: a sample of laminated veneer lumber
the layers in laminated veneer lumber

words.enDefinition: Timber members made by bonding solid wood laminations with their grain running mainly lengthwise.

examples.en: The glued-laminated timber model had several visible wood layers along its long curved side.
examples.zh: 「胶合木」模型较长的弯曲侧面上能看见好几层木材。

examples.en: We noticed that the sample of glued-laminated timber used thicker layers than the nearby veneer product.
examples.zh: 我们注意到，「胶合木」试样的各层比旁边的单板制品更厚。

words.enDefinition: An engineered wood panel made from bonded layers with adjacent grain directions typically at right angles.

examples.en: The diagram showed cross-laminated timber with the grain direction alternating from one layer to the next.
examples.zh: 示意图展示的「正交胶合木」中，相邻各层的木纹方向交替变化。

examples.en: We looked at the edge of the cross-laminated timber sample to count its visible layers.
examples.zh: 我们观察「正交胶合木」样品的边缘，数出可见的木层。

collocations: a wall made from cross-laminated timber

words.enDefinition: A wood panel made from bonded strands aligned in layers.

examples.en: The face of the oriented strand board sample showed long wood pieces aligned in similar directions.
examples.zh: 「定向刨花板」样品的表面可见方向大致相同的长条木片。

examples.en: We found oriented strand board on the materials list beside a photograph of its layered structure.
examples.zh: 我们在材料清单上找到「定向刨花板」，旁边配有其分层结构的照片。

collocations: a sample of oriented strand board

words.enDefinition: Plywood panels attached to framing to provide a continuous covering surface.

examples.en: The section identified plywood sheathing as the continuous panel layer covering the wall frame in the model.
examples.zh: 剖面把模型墙框上连续铺设的板层标为「胶合板覆板」。

examples.en: We traced the line for plywood sheathing across the drawing until it reached the corner detail.
examples.zh: 我们沿图上的「胶合板覆板」线追踪，一直找到转角详图。

words.enDefinition: The direction in which the main wood fibers run in a piece or layer.

examples.en: The teacher asked us to mark the wood grain direction on each layer in the panel sketch.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在板材草图的每一层上标出「木纹方向」。

examples.en: We matched the arrows for wood grain direction with the lines visible on the sample surface.
examples.zh: 我们把表示「木纹方向」的箭头与试样表面可见的纹线对应起来。

collocations: a change in wood grain direction

words.enDefinition: The mass of water in wood expressed relative to the wood's dry mass.

examples.en: We read the moisture content of wood as a percentage in the classroom material comparison table.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂材料比较表中读取以百分比表示的「木材含水率」。

examples.en: The report recorded the moisture content of wood before comparing changes in the dimensions of both samples.
examples.zh: 报告在比较两个试样的尺寸变化之前，记录了各自的「木材含水率」。

collocations: measure the moisture content of wood
report the moisture content of wood
compare the moisture content of wood samples

words.enDefinition: The planned order of separate concrete placements on a project.

examples.en: The instructor gave us a pour sequence drawing with separate labels for the two example areas.
examples.zh: 老师给我们一张「混凝土浇筑顺序」图，其中两个示例区域各有标签。

examples.en: We checked the pour sequence when the case study referred to a later placement on the schedule.
examples.zh: 案例提到进度表上较晚的一次浇筑时，我们核对了「混凝土浇筑顺序」。

collocations: a drawing showing the pour sequence
the pour sequence for a slab

words.enDefinition: A project form documenting a particular concrete placement and its related checks.

examples.en: The example concrete pour card listed the location of the placement discussed in our classroom case study.
examples.zh: 示例「混凝土浇筑记录卡」列出了课堂案例所讨论的浇筑位置。

examples.en: We matched the concrete pour card in the exercise to the area identified in the project notes.
examples.zh: 我们把练习中的「混凝土浇筑记录卡」与项目说明中标出的区域对应起来。

collocations: the location on a concrete pour card

words.enDefinition: A drawing identifying the location, orientation, and connections of precast components in an assembly.

examples.en: The precast erection drawing showed where each numbered panel belonged in the classroom assembly model.
examples.zh: 「预制构件安装图」显示每块带编号的面板在课堂装配模型中的位置。

examples.en: We matched the label on the photograph to the corresponding piece on the precast erection drawing.
examples.zh: 我们把照片上的标签与「预制构件安装图」中的相应构件对应起来。

collocations: a panel mark on a precast erection drawing
the orientation shown on a precast erection drawing

words.enDefinition: The molds and associated supports that shape and hold fresh concrete until it can support itself.

examples.en: The diagram used a darker outline for the formwork surrounding the fresh concrete in the model.
examples.zh: 图中用较深的轮廓线表示模型中新拌混凝土周围的「模板体系」。

examples.en: We highlighted the formwork in the photo to separate it visually from the permanent concrete element.
examples.zh: 我们在照片中高亮「模板体系」，便于区分它与永久混凝土构件。

words.enDefinition: Temporary supports, such as props or braces, placed to support construction loads or stabilize an existing structure.

examples.en: The case photograph identified shoring as the temporary upright supports beneath the unfinished deck in the model.
examples.zh: 案例照片将模型中未完工的板件下方的临时立柱标为「临时支撑」。

examples.en: We marked shoring in a different color from the permanent columns in the construction section drawing.
examples.zh: 施工剖面中，我们用不同于永久柱的颜色标出「临时支撑」。

words.enDefinition: A temporary structural assembly that supports permanent work during construction until the permanent work can carry its own loads.

examples.en: The case study drawing showed falsework beneath the unfinished model span during a temporary construction stage.
examples.zh: 案例图展示了某个临时施工阶段未完工模型跨度下的「临时承重支架」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out the falsework when tracing how the weight was carried during that stage.
examples.zh: 辅导老师分析该阶段重量由什么承受时，指出了「临时承重支架」。

words.enDefinition: A drawing showing the arrangement and geometry of forms for a concrete placement.

examples.en: The formwork drawing showed where the mold changed shape around the opening in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「模板图」显示了课堂模型中洞口周围模板形状变化的位置。

examples.en: We used the formwork drawing to match the labeled panels in the sketch with the model photograph.
examples.zh: 我们根据「模板图」，把草图里带标签的模板与模型照片中的实物对应起来。

collocations: the layout on a formwork drawing
a detail on a formwork drawing

words.enDefinition: A drawing showing the positions and identification marks of reinforcement in a construction element.

examples.en: We found the upper steel layer on the reinforcement drawing before locating it in the section photograph.
examples.zh: 我们先在「钢筋布置图」上找出上层钢筋，再到剖面照片里找相应位置。

examples.en: The reinforcement drawing used reference numbers that matched the entries in the bar bending schedule for our exercise.
examples.zh: 「钢筋布置图」所用的编号与练习里的钢筋加工明细表条目相对应。

collocations: a bar mark on a reinforcement drawing
a section on a reinforcement drawing

words.enDefinition: A plan showing how access, material movement, and temporary site use are organized during construction.

examples.en: The site logistics plan in our case study marked separate areas for deliveries and material storage.
examples.zh: 案例中的「施工现场物流布置图」分别标出了收货区和材料堆放区。

examples.en: We consulted the site logistics plan to interpret the arrows showing vehicle movements on the model site.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「施工现场物流布置图」，读懂模型现场表示车辆行进方向的箭头。

collocations: a delivery area on a site logistics plan
the access routes on a site logistics plan
